phases.objective: Deliver one synthetic-runtime Admin or Tenant request that resolves authority, persists an immutable plan, dispatches through the certified worker, and returns exact readback and reconciliation evidence.
blockers: Production-grade SQL persistence and mounted repositories are not implemented; the current memory adapters are test-only.
Admin and Tenant runtime routes are not mounted through Context Kernel and Effective Authority.
The managed worker, pinned Hostinger host key, approved binary digests, and target-bound tool discovery are not certified.
Recovery and attestation contracts are integrated but not yet consumed by a mounted execution worker.
The Synthetic Executor adapter provenance correction is integrated; execution remains in-memory with provider dispatch disabled.
The Tenant-exclusive canary post-merge hardening is integrated but remains synthetic, one-shot, and not mounted to a runtime route.
The Shared/Platform canary post-merge provenance hardening is integrated but remains synthetic, one-shot, and not mounted to a runtime route.
The Production preflight is ready for integration as a pure read-only evidence gate; it is not mounted to release orchestration and grants no deployment or Production mutation authority.
Unknown-outcome reconciliation is proven synthetically but not across a real worker restart or transport interruption.
The current phase has no mounted synthetic-runtime E2E journey.

planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: The exact operation is read back as succeeded, partially applied, held, or reconciled with durable per-item evidence and no cross-tenant leakage.
steps: Resolve Tenant, Workspace, Resource, ownership, and effective authority.
Load the immutable plan, approval set, execution lease, toolchain resolution, checkpoint, and signed attestation.
Dispatch one fixed worker operation without free-form shell input.
Persist per-item prepared and result journal records.
Read back provider and filesystem evidence.
Reconcile unknown or partial outcomes and project Tenant-safe evidence.

phases.objective: Preserve the MVP journey while adding cancellation, lease release, approval revocation, bounded retries, and operator-visible state transitions.
Prove fault injection, worker restart recovery, unknown-outcome reconciliation, checkpoint restoration, and inode-exhaustion reserve release.
Run the same journey against one allowlisted non-production Tenant root, then a governed shared/platform target with impact-set approvals.
Enable read-only Production preflight first, then require exact Production SHA and runtime readback before any separately governed mutation capability.

workstreams.title: Recovery and attestation
deliverables: Recovery checkpoint, restore verification, replica verification, signed attestation, policy parity, telemetry contracts, and fail-closed propagation into execution authorization

workstreams.title: Synthetic mutation executor
deliverables: Canonical synthetic execution protocol bound to the unified authorization bundle
In-memory exact-item mutation adapter with changed-item protection and immutable receipts

workstreams.title: Tenant-exclusive canary
deliverables: Tenant-exclusive synthetic allowlist and bounded target policy
Workspace Owner approval and manual one-shot enablement with advancing CAS tokens
Factory-provenance adapter rejection before one-shot consumption
Execution-time authority, time-window, and immutable-plan revision revalidation
ABA-safe normalized authority-token history
Tenant-safe result projection and unknown-outcome one-shot behavior
Factory-owned repository, authority-store, adapter, and one-shot registry provenance before delegated execution
TypeScript-AST import boundary for static, dynamic, CommonJS, and constant-composed Base imports

workstreams.title: Platform and shared canary
deliverables: Resolved Impact Set bound to the immutable shared/platform plan
Platform Admin and Release Authority approval with all impacted Workspace approvals or an approved quorum policy
Active Production SHA exclusion, rollback-set retention, candidate-root certification, and deployment-layout proof
Certified emergency reserve whose release remains separately authorized
Manual one-shot synthetic execution with current-authority readback and bounded projection
Factory-owned repository, adapter, authority-store, and one-shot registry provenance before any Shared authority read or consumption
TypeScript-AST boundary preventing direct Shared Core imports outside the governed wrapper
Single-read captured dependency snapshot preventing accessor or getter substitution between provenance checks and Shared Core dispatch

workstreams.title: Production preflight
deliverables: Read-only hPanel Production pressure gate with warning, critical, emergency, and measured limit policy without automatic cleanup
Exact source main candidate SHA and current Production branch/runtime SHA readback across status, health, version, and deployment-info
Verified active-root exclusion, retained rollback set, and certified candidate-root deployment layout
Canonical Shared Canary summary bound to the same release candidate with successful Evaluate/Execute, structured sources, and zero integrity findings
Secret-free immutable preflight evidence with tamper verification and single-read input capture
Separate release and Production promotion authority required; preflight never grants deployment, mutation, migration, or provider dispatch

declared_overlaps.reason: Recovery verification evidence must be consumed fail-closed by the canonical Durable execution authorization bundle.

The synthetic executor must preserve and validate the same hardened attestation, recovery, evidence-integrity, and release-provenance readbacks introduced at the Recovery and Durable integration boundary.
